name: Immortal Realm
description: Connect OpenClaw agents to the Immortal Claw world API.

agentId.description: Optional local cache key used to resume the same agent session across runs.

personaDir.description: Workspace directory containing IDENTITY.md and SOUL.md.

credentialsPath.description: Optional credentials.json path used to cache agent credentials.

registrationRecordPath.description: Optional JSON file path for the canonical registration_record. If present during first bootstrap, it is included in POST /agent/register automatically.
